propositions: run_git_write only retries HEAD-parse and bad-object read-side errors, leaving write-side temp-file faults (ENOENT/EINVAL) unretried across all callers except event_append

event_append defines its own copy of write-side fault markers and retry loop, creating asymmetric fault handling where git add self-heals but s3_doctor, compaction, and claim/transition writers hard-fail on identical faults

write-side loose-object temp-create faults ('unable to create temporary file', 'failed to insert into database', 'unable to index file') are not matched by the shared seam's transient classifier, causing s3_doctor.git commit-tree to abort with S3DoctorConflict on runner-FS blips

consolidating write-side marker family and retry logic into gitutil ensures all run_git_write callers inherit bounded 3-attempt retry with linear backoff, while preserving exclusion of corrupt-object signatures and ensuring genuinely persistent faults fail loudly
